description: Use this when someone wants a day-by-day Galápagos itinerary for a land-based (island-hopping) trip: which islands, how many nights on each, ferry days and what to do each day for a wildlife, snorkelling or budget focus, from arrival at Baltra (GPS) or San Cristóbal (SCY) to departure. Shows a route map card. All inputs are optional. Examples: "Plan 7 days of island hopping in the Galápagos." / "Arma un itinerario de 7 días por las islas Galápagos."

arrive_airport.description: gps = Baltra for Santa Cruz (default), scy = San Cristóbal.

days.description: Days including arrival and departure day (default 7).

focus.description: wildlife (default), snorkel or budget (free walk-in sites first).

islands.description: Islands to sleep on, 1–3 (default 2). Trips under 5 days use one island, under 7 at most two.

name: plan_itinerary

link.description: Page on galapagosislands.info with these inputs filled in.

title: Galápagos island-hopping plan
